wayfix.option.title: WayFix Options
wayfix.option.autoScaleGUI.tooltip: Auto-scales the GUI scale depending on your display's scaling.
wayfix.option.autoScaleGUI.tooltip2: (e.g. 2 GUI Scale on 1920x1080 at 100% → 4 GUI Scale on 3840x2160 at 200%)
wayfix.option.injectIcon.tooltip: Injects the Minecraft Icon at Startup instead of defaulting to the normal Wayland icon (requires restart).
wayfix.option.keyModifiersFix.tooltip: Fixes keyboard combinations such as 'CTRL + A' or 'CTRL + C' being sent in chat.
wayfix.option.monitorName.tooltip: Full-screens the window in the selected monitor.
wayfix.option.monitorName.tooltip3: By default Minecraft sometimes full-screens on the wrong monitor due to Wayland limitations.
wayfix.toast.restart-game.title: WayFix: Restart your game!
wayfix.toast.restart-game.description: The early loading screen has been disabled.
